WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.186327 39.533089)', 4326)::geometry AS g
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT r.road_name,
         r.geometry::geometry AS geom,
         ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.186327 39.533089)', 4326)::geography) AS dist_m
  FROM roads r, ref
  WHERE r.highway = 'living_street'
    AND r.road_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Dimension(r.geometry::geometry) = 1
    AND ST_NPoints(r.geometry::geometry) BETWEEN 2 AND 50
    AND r.geometry::geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-126, 24, -66, 50, 4326)
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.186327 39.533089)', 4326)::geography, 100000)
  ORDER BY r.geometry::geometry <-> ref.g
  LIMIT 1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(n.geom)).geom AS seg FROM nearest n
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
         ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
         ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT e.seg_len_m,
         z1.v AS z1,
         z2.v AS z2
  FROM endpoints e
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p1) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p1)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z1 ON z1.v IS NOT NULL
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p2) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z2 ON z2.v IS NOT NULL
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT seg_len_m,
         CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.road_name,
       n.dist_m,
       DEGREES(ATAN(SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0))) AS slope_deg
FROM nearest n
CROSS JOIN slopes
WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.road_name, n.dist_m;

WITH stadium_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE 'Cal, Sr.%Yard'
    AND addr_city = 'Aberdeen'
    AND addr_state = 'MD'
),
nearest_road AS (
  SELECT 
    r.id,
    r.geometry,
    ST_Distance(s.geometry::geometry, r.geometry::geometry) AS distance_meters
  FROM 
    stadium_geom s
  JOIN 
    roads r
    ON ST_DWithin(s.geometry::geometry, r.geometry::geometry, 1000) -- 1 km buffer
  WHERE 
    r.highway = 'living_street'
  ORDER BY 
    s.geometry::geometry <-> r.geometry::geometry
  LIMIT 1
),
road_profile AS (
  SELECT 
    nr.id,
    nr.geometry,
    nr.distance_meters,
    ST_Area(ST_Transform(ST_Envelope(nr.geometry), 32633)) / 30 AS num_cells,
    (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Union(ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, nr.geometry::geometry, TRUE))).sum) / 
    (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Union(ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, nr.geometry::geometry, TRUE))).count) AS avg_elevation,
    (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Union(ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, nr.geometry::geometry, TRUE))).max - 
     ST_SummaryStats(ST_Union(ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, nr.geometry::geometry, TRUE))).min) / 
    ST_Length(ST_Transform(nr.geometry, 32633)) * 100 AS avg_grade_percent
  FROM 
    nearest_road nr
  JOIN 
    public.dem_us
    ON ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, nr.geometry::geometry)
  GROUP BY 
    nr.id, nr.geometry, nr.distance_meters
)
SELECT 
  'living_street' AS road_type,
  distance_meters,
  avg_grade_percent
FROM 
  road_profile;
